summary: First Bancorp filed an 8-K regarding a definitive merger agreement to acquire First Carolina Bancshares for aggregate consideration of ~$166 million, or $64.22 per share, composed of 14.5340 shares of First Bancorp common stock plus $294.94 cash per share. Both boards unanimously approved the deal, which is expected to close in Q4 2026 or early Q1 2027, pending First Carolina shareholder approval, regulatory clearances, and effectiveness of a registration statement. A June 30, 2027 termination date applies. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder vote for risk-arb spreads.
